scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the sign of the stationary radial excess fourth-moment statistic in a two-dimensional fully Poisson-reset active Brownian particle with positive confinement and reset rate. A zero statistic is not proof of a Gaussian law. It neither covers partial resetting nor finite-time or finite-sample phases. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Unique activity threshold and exactly two trapping crossovers for a completely reset active Brownian particle
